metadata.title: Certified spectral floors of Q₈ connections on the Chair44 hull
metadata.description: Certified two-sided bounds on the spectral floor E_* of the pinned Chair44 operator over all 1 679 616 frame rules: the maximiser is one of 1387, 539311, 539291 [C]; 1389 is excluded by a preregistered radius-24 certificate. Contents: the Phase XII decision memo, the strongest theorems of Phases XI and XII, and the repository README. Code, data and Lean certificates: https://github.com/dewarjoseph/- . AI-assisted; every claim labelled [P]/[C]/[E]/[X]/[F].
